data.gender_notes: Najood is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Winner, Triumphant, Conquering. The name Najood carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Najood usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who will be victorious in her spiritual journey and will be a source of inspiration and guidance for others.
data.etymology: Najood belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najood total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نَجود

in_urdu.name: نَجود

Najood is a name that symbolizes goodness, virtue, and righteousness. It is a name that inspires women to be good role models and to strive for excellence in all aspects of life. Najood is a name that is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition and is highly regarded in Muslim cultures around the world.

data.cultural_impact: The name Najood holds a strong cultural significance in the Islamic tradition, symbolizing success, victory, and domination. It is a name that represents dominance over adversity and a spirit of triumph. The Arabic root words "naj" and "jud" meaning "conquer" and "victory," respectively, further illuminate the name's cultural meaning. Najood is a powerful name for parents who wish to inspire their children with the spirit of winning and triumphing over challenges.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Najood also holds deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture, representing the triumph of faith over hardship and the power of Allah to grant victory to those who remain steadfast in their belief. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "And when Allah intends to bestow favor upon anyone, He calls upon the angels to make mention of [that person] before Him [i.e., Allah] forty nights, and He says, 'Record the name of the one I love.'" (Bukhari 2691). The name Najood can be seen as a reminder of Allah's love and support, and the power of faith to help us overcome our challenges. It can serve as an inspiration for believers to continually strive towards spiritual growth and victory in life.
